title: Fix Lower Right Panel Tab Order
description: Fix the bug where pressing lower-right panel toggles such as Settings reverses the visible panel tab order. Preserve declared tab order across fold, unfold, and active-tab changes; add regression coverage and verify behavior.
summary: Fixed right-anchored panel tab reversal by isolating each tab row from the panel root spatial RTL flow, preserving declared left-to-right visual and keyboard order across folded and open chrome hosts. Updated dock-drop hit testing to match the preserved order, added toggle-path and insertion-order regression tests, and added a bottom-right chrome-hosted Panel Storybook fixture. Focused Nx tests pass (2/2). The full UI suite and typecheck remain blocked by unrelated pre-existing shared-worktree failures and missing generated modules/WASM artifacts.
